item.title: Libya: the situation
item.description:
Libyan forces continue artillery strikes on Haftar positions while Haftar militia members surrendered at a strategic airbase, and Turkish officials publicly welcomed a motion supporting the troops. A suspected Ukrainian drone struck a Russian vessel near Benghazi, and airstrikes destroyed ammunition depots at the Benghazi naval base, causing explosions. An armed group blocked the Hamada oil pipeline for over 20 days, costing $31 million in losses for the National Oil Corporation. China is re-engaging in Libya with military forces linked to recent business deals. There were 2 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
